英語文 · 國二下學期 · 章節筆記

連綴動詞、感官動詞與最高級比較

Linking verbs (look, sound, smell, taste, feel) describe sensory perception and are followed by adjectives, or "like" + nouns. Sensory verbs (see, hear, watch, notice) take an object followed by a base verb (entire action) or V-ing (action in progress). Superlatives compare three or more items using the + -est/most.

章節重點

原級同等比較
as + 形容詞/副詞原級 + as（和...一樣）He is as smart as his brother. / She sings as beautifully as a bird.
否定同等比較
not as/so + 原級 + as（不及...；不如...）This book is not as interesting as that movie. (That movie is more interesting.)
越來越... (More and more)
單音節用比較級 and 比較級；多音節用 more and more + 原級It is getting colder and colder. / The city is becoming more and more crowded.

示範與推理

修正「The soup tastes well. I saw Ken crossed the street. He is tallest of the three boys.」，並說明原因。

  1. soup 的味道用形容詞 good 描述，改為 The soup tastes good.；well 通常作副詞，不能在此表湯味好。
  2. 感官句可寫 I saw Ken cross the street.，看見過街事件；或 saw Ken crossing，著眼正在過街的過程，不能接 crossed 當第二個限定動詞。
  3. 三人中最高使用 He is the tallest of the three boys.，加上 the 並保留範圍。

易錯提醒　Do not use adverbs after linking verbs (say "The flower smells sweet", not "sweetly"). Do not forget the definite article "the" before superlatives.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. The fresh bread from the oven smells ___ and looks attractive.
    • A．deliciously
    • B．delicious
    • C．more delicious
    • D．most deliciously
  2. Write a food review describing a meal using three different sensory linking verbs and one superlative statement.
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　B（delicious）。The linking verb "smells" takes a predicative adjective ("delicious"), not an adverb.

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
